title: Rules agents must follow (pickup, cancellation, scanning)
keywords: agent rules cancel ban accepted job scan waybill timeslot stacking
body: Only accept jobs you can pick up within the window; check size fits the vehicle.
All deliveries follow the timeslot unless CS says otherwise.
Cancelling an accepted job leads to a ban, except the pickup cases (seller closed, not ready, under-declared) done with CS and proof.
Scan all items against the waybill at pickup; scan again before delivery.
